## Requirements (from the spec's In-scope Stage A)
1. Settings shell `/app/settings/{account,preferences,notifications,integrations,billing,data}`
   (§4.2 paths; beta `/settings` migrates; Team hidden) — full-page, 640-px column, dark shell, `⌘,`.
2. Account: name, byline, email (magic-link change), avatar, sign-in methods, sessions+revoke,
   delete account.
3. Preferences: model tier (no raw model names), rigor default, per-project overrides win,
   confirmation threshold (≤1,000, REQ-BILL-4), approval-policy default, editor prefs
   (paper theme, font preset, size stepper).
4. Notifications: §5.11 matrix vs P1.19 server-side prefs; the two non-configurable rows enforced;
   quiet-hours editing.
5. Integrations (REQ-ACCT-2): one card component — connect/status/items/disconnect over P1.15's
   providers; disconnect removes tokens immediately, keeps samples; never-does line per card.
6. Billing: render P1.16's surfaces under the new tree.
7. Data: Export everything (P1.18) · Delete account (typed confirmation → 14-day grace → banner +
   cancel → hard-delete via `accountDeletionPlan`; REQ-ACCT-4) · privacy toggles (analytics opt-out
   carried + support-access 72-h grant with user-visible log, REQ-VIS-11) · training-posture +
   residual-risk verbatim · no DPA/SOC2 — "Enterprise? Ask us about a DPA".
8. Preference-profile posture copy (REQ-OBJ-14): §11.7 toggle copy verbatim, default-on + first-class
   opt-out; flag stored + capture path honors + contract documented; profile rides the zip, dies with
   deletion.
9. Project settings `/p/:project/settings`: voice link, protocol & venue (REQ-GENRE-2 safe fields),
   approval policy (REQ-GATE-3), rigor default, paper theme, standing-guidance list (REQ-GATE-10
   management half — P1.09's section), tags placeholder.
10. Deterministic verification green; deletion state machine, toggle enforcements, non-configurable
    rows tested.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] six-section tree at §4.2 paths; ⌘, opens it; every section renders §14.7 contents; Team hidden
      — `settings-pages.test.ts` asserts the nav strip renders exactly the six sections on every
      section page and `data-section="team"`/`>Team<` appear nowhere; `ide.ts` ⌘, →
      `/app/settings/account`; legacy `/settings` + `/app/settings` 302 to the account section.
- [x] Preferences apply; per-project overrides win; confirmation threshold clamps at 1,000; no raw
      model names (vocabulary lint) — `sheet-context` resolves project→workflow→account→'standard';
      `model_tier_default` NULL inherits live (project create no longer stamps it); web POST clamps
      `consentUnder` at 1,000 server-side; copy lint green (the two "gate" slips fixed to canonical
      "Spend limit"/"Wait for me at each").
- [x] two non-configurable notification rows cannot be disabled via API or UI (REQ-ACCT-1);
      prefs round-trip through P1.19's store — api 400s a `spend_gate`/`trial_payment` write
      (P1.19's store, unchanged); the web table renders "Always on" with no select for those rows
      and redirects `?notice=rejected` on a refused write. `readNotificationPrefs` now returns the
      raw prefs blob so the in-app/digest/per-project arms render.
- [x] Integration cards uniform; disconnect removes tokens immediately + keeps samples; never-does
      line (REQ-ACCT-2) — one card per provider with status/handle/persona/item counts/last-sync/
      error + the per-provider "never" line; `DELETE /voices/:id/connections/:cid` now nulls
      `auth_ref` in the same write (items/samples retained); `settings/integrations/:id/disconnect`
      does the same account-side.
- [x] Delete account: typed confirmation → 14-day grace → hard-delete; fixture asserts anonymized
      ledger + Stripe customer survive, content+PII gone (REQ-ACCT-4; live round-trip = Stage B) —
      literal `delete` confirmation → `deletion_requested_at` + `account.hard-delete` job at the
      grace end; re-request does NOT extend the clock; cancel clears the marker (the worker re-reads
      it and no-ops); `handleAccountHardDelete` anonymizes `usage_records`, cascades content+PII,
      retains `billing_accounts`/`credit_ledger`/`credit_balances`.
- [x] support-access toggle grants 72-h-expiring access + audit row per access + user-visible log
      (REQ-VIS-11); analytics opt-out removes the user's events (REQ-PROD-15 carried) — `support_
      access_grants` (72 h, one active) + `support_access_log` (granted/revoked/accessed/expired —
      newest-first, user-visible); the admin `support-access` CLI leg refuses without a live grant
      and dual-writes the log + `admin_actions` ('support_access' vocab). Analytics opt-out is the
      carried `user.analytics_opt_out` — same column, moved into Data only (no duplicate surface).
- [x] Q-26 copy verbatim; opt-out stored + honored by capture path within a minute; profile rides
      the zip + dies with deletion (REQ-OBJ-14) — `user.prefs.preferenceOptOut`; `captureGuidanceTx`
      stamps `preference_signal = preferenceCaptureEnabled(prefs)` at write time (fail-closed on a
      lookup error); the zip carries `preferences.prefs`; the `"user"` cascade kills the blob.
- [x] Project settings: approval-policy change leaves open cards untouched (REQ-GATE-3); standing
      guidance lists/edits/retires (REQ-GATE-10 management half) — the approvals POST is P1.09's
      endpoint unchanged (open `gates` rows are never touched by a policy write); `PUT
      /projects/:id/guidance/:gid` edits body/workflows in place (409 on retired), retire stays
      P1.09's.
- [x] Stage B legs green or `D-P1.20-*` rows (live — $0) → `D-P1.20-1` (dev deploy + migration 0040
      + the live deletion/support-access/export legs, operator-gated).

## Plan
- **0040_settings_account.sql**: `user.prefs jsonb` (settings prefs blob), `user.deletion_requested_at`,
  `user.byline`; `support_access_grants` + `support_access_log` (REQ-VIS-11); `admin_actions` vocab +
  `support_access`; `projects.protocol_changed_at` + `protocol_overrides jsonb` (REQ-GENRE-2).
- **contracts**: `settings.ts` — `SETTINGS_SECTIONS`, `userPrefsSchema`, `projectSettingsPatchSchema`
  (safe fields only), `ACCOUNT_DELETION_CONFIRMATION`, `SUPPORT_ACCESS_TTL_MS`.
- **api `settings-routes.ts`**: account read/update (name/byline/avatar), sessions list + revoke,
  email-change request/confirm (`verification` row + `auth.mail` enqueue), prefs GET/PUT,
  data read (privacy + support grant + log + deletion state), support-access toggle (72-h grant +
  audit rows), preference-profile opt-out, delete account (typed confirmation → `deletion_requested_at`
  + `account.hard-delete` startAfter 14 d) + cancel, integrations aggregate + disconnect (token wipe),
  project settings GET/PUT (venue/protocol/rigor/paper/overrides; protocol change → `protocol_changed_at`).
- **worker**: `deletion.ts` gains `hardDeleteAccount` (fixture-verified: content+PII gone, anonymized
  ledger + Stripe customer survive); `main.ts` registers the `account.hard-delete` consumer.
- **archive**: state.json `preferences` block gains `preferenceProfile` (opt-out flag + captured-signal
  counts) — REQ-OBJ-14 "rides the zip".
- **api-client**: DTOs + methods for all new endpoints.
- **web**: `SettingsShell` (nav rail, 640-px column), six section pages, `ProjectSettingsPage`,
  routes + server GET/POSTs; legacy `/settings` + `/settings/billing` GETs redirect into the tree
  (POST action paths keep working); `⌘,` → `/app/settings`; IDE nav rows point at the new paths.
- **Choices recorded**: typed confirmation = the account's email address? — no: literal `delete`
  (spec says "typed confirmation" without pinning the string); account-level defaults stamp at
  project-create and remain the fallback for projects that never override (projects carry their own
  value, which IS the override); tags omitted on project settings (1.x) — placeholder line only.

## Evidence report
Stage A is complete and verified deterministically: the six-section §14.7 settings tree lives at
the §4.2 `/app/settings/*` paths (⌘, lands on Account; legacy `/settings` + `/settings/billing`
GETs/POSTs still work), Account covers profile/sign-in-methods/sessions/email-change/delete-link,
Preferences writes the `user.prefs` blob with null-unset semantics and the ≤1,000-credit clamp,
Notifications rides P1.19's store with the two locked rows un-writable from UI or API, Integrations
renders the uniform provider cards with same-write credential removal, Billing is P1.16's surface
canonical at `/app/settings/billing`, Data carries the analytics opt-out + the 72-h support grant
with its user-visible log + the verbatim Q-26/training-posture copy + Export-everything + the
typed-`delete` 14-day-grace account deletion (worker `account.hard-delete` destroys content+PII,
retains anonymized ledger + Stripe customer), and `/p/:slug/settings` exposes the REQ-GENRE-2 safe
fields + the P1.09 approval/guidance management. A settings-page protocol change stamps
`projects.protocol_changed_at`; the next Review's scope card carries the marker + the blocking
consequence, and a non-deduped launch clears it. Q-26 capture stamps `guidance.preference_signal`
at write time (honest capture-only — no aggregation machinery). Team stays hidden. Stage B (live
deploy + deletion/support/export legs) is `D-P1.20-1`.
